To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the strain energy density based fatigue life models can predict the temperature cycling induced fatigue life of SAC solder joints with reasonable accuracy.

(i) strain energy density based solder joint fatigue models are widely used in the industry, (ii) the strain energy density based model constants for the SAC solder materials have not been reported in the literature, (iii) a strain energy density based SAC solder joint fatigue model is proposed, (iv) the model constants for the proposed SAC solder fatigue model are reported.
the strain energy density based model constants for the SAC305 solder material were determined to be 0.0005 MPa and 0.0002 for the strain energy and plastic strain energy terms, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a strain energy based model to predict the temperature cycling induced fatigue life of SAC solder joints.
developing a new model to predict the temperature cycling life of SAC solder joints based on the strain energy density.
developing a strain energy density based fatigue life model that is suitable for the SAC solders.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current strain energy density based fatigue life model constants for LF solders are insufficient for use in temperature cycling fatigue life estimation.
the strain energy density based fatigue models are not accurate enough to predict fatigue life for SAC solders.
there is no one single model that can be used for all LF solder alloys.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the energy density based models for solder fatigue life estimation are still valid.
the strain energy density model can predict the fatigue life of SAC solder joints with reasonable accuracy.
the strain energy density based model is a good model for predicting the fatigue life of solder joints.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the fatigue life model constants for SAC solder materials are similar to those of eutectic SnPb solder materials.
the strain energy density based model is capable of accurately predicting fatigue life of solder joints under temperature cycling loading.
strain energy density based fatigue life models can be used to predict the reliability of LF solders with the appropriate model constants for each solder material.
